verdict.rationale: The axis applies to a work-management product like monday.com, but the pack never documents native board, list, calendar, or timeline views of the same work, or switching between them. The only related item, monday-docs-3, describes a developer framework for building custom board views. That is a building block, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work

citations.quote: Create custom board views, item views, dashboard widgets, and full-page apps.
